items.text: Patriots officially placed A.J. Brown on IR with high ankle sprain; out minimum 4 games.
items.why: Schefter report + official placement; Rapoport earlier severity.
items.implication: Maye loses WR1; Doubs/Hollins/others elevated targets for weeks 2-5+.
items.opportunity: NE WR target share redistribution; waiver candidates in NE room.

items.text: Brock Bowers listed OUT for Sunday after meniscus procedure; expected 1-2 weeks.
items.why: Official ETR Sunday injury report and Schefter confirmation of procedure.
items.implication: Raiders TE void; higher target share/volume for remaining pass-catchers and Jeanty as focal point.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Mayer and WRs; Jeanty workload boost.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty listed IN and fully cleared after ankle issue that tanked ADP; full participant all week and off injury report.
items.why: ETR clearance + Schefter official off report/good-to-go; Levitan notes ADP tankers mostly cleared.
items.implication: Start with confidence as lead back vs MIA; Bowers OUT further concentrates offense.
items.opportunity: High snap/carry share expected; manage early but RB1 upside.

items.text: Malik Nabers listed QUESTIONABLE (knee); God will tell him if playing per Levitan; Giants elevated Berrios/Cambre.
items.why: ETR report + Schefter/Rapoport Q listing and elevations.
items.implication: GTD risk; if out, Fields/Mooney/others rise; if in, limited? Monitor active.
items.opportunity: If OUT, WR target vacuum; Likely TE upside noted elsewhere.

items.text: Christian McCaffrey usage concerns and Kaelon Black looking good are overreactions; banged up preseason + long flight + weird game; CMC is a BUY LOW.
items.why: Berry contrarian take on Happy Hour after early usage frets.
items.implication: Hold/buy; expect rebound to feature role.
items.opportunity: Snap/target share should normalize; trade market undervalues.
items.conflict: Conflicts with some early snap frets if Black steals.

items.text: Sean Tucker (hamstring) DOUBTFUL/absence gives sneaky goal-line boost to Bucky Irving and Kenny Gainwell.
items.why: Levitan direct take on ETR report; Tucker led prior GL/red-zone.
items.implication: Irving/Gainwell elevated TD equity and short-yardage; Irving especially for early-down/GL.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone carries and snaps shift; startable RB2/flex bumps.

items.text: Alvin Kamara (knee) QUESTIONABLE status a bit impactful for Travis Etienne projection; Kamara full practice Friday but Q tag.
items.why: Levitan on ETR report; full Friday practice but designation remains.
items.implication: If Kamara limited/out, Etienne volume/role expands in NO backfield.
items.opportunity: Etienne snaps/carries/routes upside if Kamara restricted.

items.text: Malik Davis OUT (hip from Friday practice) and placed on IR; Cowboys signed Abanikanda.
items.why: ETR OUT + Schefter IR placement after Friday injury.
items.implication: Late-round handcuff loss per Levitan; Javonte primary with new depth.
items.opportunity: Reduced DAL RB handcuff value; monitor Abanikanda/Javonte snaps.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase listed IN after camp knee scare; expected to play fully.
items.why: ETR IN list; practiced and cleared.
items.implication: WR1 lock vs TB; no volume loss.

items.text: Tua OUT, Cooper Rush starts (despite back spasms); not ideal but not train wreck—lower expectations yet still start Bijan, London, Pitts; Rush serviceable.
items.why: Berry reaction to Tua OUT/Rush start reports.
items.implication: Slight downgrade but locked starters; volume remains.
items.opportunity: Bijan workhorse; London/Pitts targets intact vs PIT.

items.text: Chuba Hubbard is a viable flex this week; 'keeping it open' on The Chubbler amid Brooks groin notes but Hubbard full practices.
items.why: Berry Happy Hour keep-open flex call.
items.opportunity: Lead back snaps/carries if Brooks limited.

items.text: Rome Odunze (calf) QUESTIONABLE but says he's playing; Levitan notes expected to go.
items.why: Player statement via Levitan on ETR Q list.
items.implication: Startable if active; monitor final inactive.
items.opportunity: CHI WR routes if cleared; dock possible for camp miss.

items.text: Emeka Egbuka listed IN (toe) and good to go; ADP tanker clearance.
items.why: ETR IN + Levitan notes clearance of August injury ADP drops; Rapoport good-to-go.
items.implication: Viable WR start/flex with role intact.

items.text: Saquon Barkley makes the Love List for Week 1 vs Commanders (historical dominance: 136+ rush yds, 6.0 YPC, 21+ PPR in prior matchups).
items.why: Berry Love List + 10 Facts historical vs WAS; front seven still below avg.
items.opportunity: High carry/red-zone expectation in favorable matchup.
